nieuw.titel: Compare both armies' ranges before deploying defensively
nieuw.tekst: Know how far your own army can move and shoot, and compare its shooting range with the enemy's, including magic missiles. Check enemy charge distances and whether their chargers have Swiftstride.
nieuw.waarom: He says that without knowing enemy charge ranges, you will struggle to deploy to avoid those threats or whittle them down before they reach you.

nieuw.titel: Deploy as though you will go second
nieuw.tekst: When the first turn is still unknown, deploy defensively as though the opponent will act first. Protect the important parts of your army and leave few worthwhile opening targets.
nieuw.waarom: He has been caught out too often by losing the first turn. He says that knowing he would go first would let him deploy more aggressively and remove threats before they could return fire.
nieuw.voorbeeld: Against High Elves, he hid most of his army and left only a few shooting targets. His important units survived the opening turn, then moved out to remove an archer unit and a bolt thrower.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says he could deploy much more aggressively if he knew he was going first.

nieuw.titel: Deploy beyond enemy movement plus shooting range
nieuw.tekst: To avoid opening shooting losses, deploy far enough away that enemy shooters cannot reach you even after moving. Measure their movement and shooting reach together.
nieuw.waarom: He wants to avoid taking losses before his own first turn.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He deployed his Glade Riders beyond the Outriders' combined movement and shooting reach. If he went second they could not move and shoot him; if he went first he could move up and shoot them.

nieuw.titel: Clear fast and ranged threats with Wood Elves
nieuw.tekst: With Wood Elves, prioritise removing the enemy's fast and ranged threats. Use that clearance to bring your mobility advantage into play against the remaining army.
nieuw.waarom: He says even enemy dogs can kill his Toughness 3 troops. Against the infantry-heavy High Elf army, removing ranged threats made his mobility the biggest factor in the game.
nieuw.voorbeeld: Against High Elves, his protected army moved out after the opening turn and removed an archer unit and a bolt thrower. He believes this defensive deployment gave him the advantage by about turn two.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He wanted to remove the Skin Wolves early, but found that difficult because they were quick and reached combat, where he struggled to shoot them.
